route_note: Take an Amtrak Hiawatha train from Chicago Union Station to Milwaukee Intermodal Station, about 1.5 hours direct, then walk or take a short local bus or rideshare to the lakefront museums.
see: Milwaukee Art Museum and its lakefront Calatrava wing
Historic Third Ward shops and restaurants
Brewery tour at Pabst Mansion or a local brewery

route_note: Take the South Shore Line commuter train from Millennium Station in Chicago directly to Michigan City, about 1.5 hours, then use a taxi or rideshare to reach the Indiana Dunes beaches and trails.
see: Dune trails such as Mount Baldy
Washington Park Beach and Michigan City lakefront
tour_query: Indiana Dunes day trip from Chicago
